svg.title: Strategy · Gain harvesting wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / STRATEGY / GAIN HARVESTING
Realize gains inside a chosen bracket, then rebuy.
Gains are realized only up to the top of the chosen bracket, then the asset is rebought and basis resets.
Harvesting never pushes income past the selected bracket ceiling.
Next year's taxable gain falls by the same amount.
Turn on harvesting after adding a taxable or crypto account.
Zero state is explicit, not an error.
Harvesting is enabled per plan with a bracket and a year range. Outside the range nothing is realized.
Each harvest sells and immediately rebuys, so the asset stays owned and the basis rises by the realized gain.
Tax effect uses the same result pipeline: baseline and harvesting runs are compared by the backend.
With no taxable or crypto account the total is $0 and the empty state explains why.
